topics: Performance Analysis - Time & Space Complexity, Asymptotic Notations
Evaluation of Expressions- Infix to Postfix
Singly Linked List - Operations on Linked List
Stacks and Queues using Linked List
Memory allocation - First-fit, Best-fit, and Worst-fit allocation schemes
Binary Search Trees - Binary Search Tree Operations
Depth First Search and Breadth First Search
Applications of Graphs  - Single Source All Destination
Hashing - Hashing functions : Mid square, Division, Folding, Digit Analysis
Collision Resolution :  Linear probing, Quadratic Probing, Double hashing, Open hashing

Each question carries 9 marks.

courseOutcomes.description: Identify appropriate data structures for solving real world problems.
Describe and implement linear data structures such as arrays, linked lists, stacks, and queues.
Describe and Implement non linear data structures such as trees and graphs.
Select appropriate searching and sorting algorithms to be used in specific circumstances.
